verdict.summary: The change replaces the stale hand-maintained regate collision list with a tree-derived schedule map, moves regate-sweep off the live latch-watchdog collision, and preserves fail-closed behavior for missing workflow trees, import failures, parse failures, and thin checkouts. The workflow sparse checkout includes both the owning module and the complete workflows directory with exact-membership assertions. The new fixture and live-seam checks exercise cron expansion, map coverage, lane-count evidence, self-lane agreement, positive and negative collision cases, and the production call site. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes.
